制作过程过于速成  很多地方优化的并不是很好

This wallpaper is only released alongside the major version update and serves as a demonstration of the features. 
The production process was too rushed, and many aspects are not well optimized. 
It's just meant to be a simple experience for testing the new version's functionality. 
Since this feature is supported, there is no need to rush. 
Many creators will join in later. 
Thank you all for using it; I appreciate it.
